cards.title: Why two doors
items: The agent and its webui share ONE process — the agent POSTing to its own loopback was a pure socket detour (#1572 answered 'why HTTP?').
Validation and frame construction live in shared src/report-frame.ts so BOTH doors emit byte-identical frames; the HTTP route simply delegates.
webui_report is core/always-on and non-blocking: publish is the natural epilogue of generating content, not an on-demand capability.

cards.title: Frame contract (both doors)
items: title trimmed to 1-200 chars; EXACTLY ONE of markdown | html; body cap 128KB.
source label capped at 100 (default 'agent' for the tool, 'api' for the route); frame id report-<ts36>-<rand>.
Errors never throw: the tool returns error RESULTs, the route returns 400 / 413.

cards.title: Durability
items: Store-wrapped broadcaster: every report is broadcast live AND appended to the replay store.
Report frames are exempt from the bounded card-eviction cap — the Report tab is the archive surface.
Reports survive browser refresh and WS reconnect (snapshot replay); the store is in-memory, so a process restart clears history.
